name: Ian Stapleton
title: Clinical, Child and Educational Psychologist
description: Ian is a clinical psychologist with many years experience in private practice. Ian is also a family therapist and sex therapist, and an experienced hypnotherapist. He works with adults, families, teenagers and children, across all areas of psychology.
specialties: Sex therapy, Relationship issues, Hypnotherapy, Family therapy, Adolescents

name: Rachel Pulfer
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Rachel is an experienced clinical psychologist who works with children, adolescents, adults, couples and families affected by psychological problems such as depression, anxiety, school refusal, stress, grief, trauma, autism, eating disorders, personality disorders, relationship issues and OCD.
specialties: Trauma, Children, Adolescents, Couples, Families, DBT, ACT

name: Christie McKay
title: General Psychologist
description: Christie uses CBT, Interpersonal Therapy, Schema Therapy, Mindfulness, Self-Compassion Therapy and Solution Focussed Therapy, working with adults, couples and adolescents. She has particular training in relationship counselling and couples therapy and a special interest in attachment. Also experienced in treating post traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), domestic violence and personality disorders.
specialties: Schema Therapy, PTSD, Couples therapy, Attachment, Domestic violence

name: Peter Brown
title: Psychologist
description: Peter's areas of practice include personality disorder, identity issues, sexual abuse, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), family violence and more. He has trained in modalities including Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing Therapy (EMDR), Transference-Focused Psychotherapy, DBT, Gestalt therapy and clinical hypnosis. Available for Face-to-Face and Telehealth (Video) sessions.
specialties: EMDR, PTSD, Sexual abuse, Identity issues, Family violence, DBT

name: Rita Newman
title: General Psychologist
description: Rita supports adults and adolescents experiencing stress, anxiety, depression, eating disorders, life transitions, relationship challenges, trauma and grief. Also available for telehealth, telephone and video sessions; offers ADHD assessments for adults and teens.
specialties: Trauma, Grief, Anxiety, ADHD assessment, CBT

name: Rajesh Thalappillil
title: General Psychologist
description: Rajesh has assisted clients with depression, anxiety, relationship issues, trauma related conditions, grief and life transitions. He uses evidence-based therapies including CBT, SFT, DBT, ACT and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing Therapy (EMDR). Offers both face-to-face and telehealth (video) sessions.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, ADHD/autism assessment, Children, Adolescents

name: Rachael Perry
title: General Psychologist
description: Rachael has a deep interest in supporting women navigating perimenopause and menopause. She welcomes referrals for adults and adolescents (15+) seeking support for anxiety, relationship challenges, emotional regulation, workplace burnout and navigating significant life changes, trauma and grief. Available for face-to-face and telehealth (video) consultations.
